required_findings.criteria: Rejects the assertion that green automated audits prove accessibility or legal compliance.
Distinguishes technical standards such as WCAG and EN 301 549 from legal obligations such as EAA, ADA, and Section 508.
Requires product, organization, market, and jurisdiction scope to be established before making legal applicability statements.
Requires maintained release-specific evidence including automated results, manual assistive-technology checks, limitations, and unresolved issues.

forbidden_claims: Provides legal advice or guarantees compliance
Treats WCAG as a law in every jurisdiction
Claims one report remains valid for all future releases
